newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Placer Dome to mop up Australian unit.
newsitem.headline: Placer Dome to mop up Australian unit.

text.p: Canada's Placer Dome Inc said on Friday it would move to compulsorily acquire the remaining shares in its Australian unit Placer Pacific Ltd.
Placer Dome said in a statement it had acquired 97.69 percent of Placer Pacific since launching its bid last November for the 24.6 percent of the company it did now already own.
Placer Dome bid at the same time for Papua New Guinea miner Highlands Gold Ltd, which owns 25 percent of the giant Porgera gold mine.
Highlands recommended its shareholders accept the bid after a restructuring agreement, which enabled its other assets to be floated off, and Placer Dome moved to compulsory acquisition in February.
Placer had valued the two bids at about US$600 million.
